plan.objective: Make local-runner LinkedIn sync and invitation mutation trustworthy by using deterministic same-credential Unipile HTTP first for configured read and supported write paths, making config failures loud, and proving the invitation lifecycle through existing owners.
acceptanceCriteria: A configured scheduled host-pass Unipile list pull does not default to agent_handoff.
The host-pass test proves the first runInboundContractImpl call carries directUnipileHttp: true for configured managed LinkedIn accounts.
Supported Unipile maintenance mutations do not default to MCP handoff.
send_connection_request attempts the deterministic same-credential Unipile send first for configured managed accounts and does not default to MCP handoff.
Send tasks cannot locally record success or open connection-request proof debt unless the external write path actually returned success.
Missing Unipile config never produces a quiet zero-item success.
The pass result includes a clear transport and config or fallback reason.
Existing surface-state fields carry trust, backoff, continuation, and partial-status information.
Existing invitation reconciliation owner remains the only place deciding pending, accepted, no-longer-pending, and not-accepted outcomes.
constraints: Backend first. No frontend redesign in this board.
Use TDD. Write or update failing tests before implementation changes.
No live external sends, withdrawals, accepts, declines, replies, or deploys in default tests.
Tests use fixtures or injected HTTP implementations only unless an env-gated smoke test is explicitly enabled.
Do not hard-code a tenant Unipile host in product code.
Do not bypass managed account identity checks.
Do not rely on webhook triggers in local-runner mode.
Do not create parallel state primitive files unless a test proves the existing owners cannot express the behavior.
nonGoals: No browser-profile fallback for governed truth.
No Gmail sent-mail proof implementation in this board.
No LinkedIn entitlements, public engagement retrieval, or HubSpot CRM surfaces in this board.

tasks.title: Add deterministic Unipile send for connection requests
tasks.context: Plan Phase 2, send half. send_connection_request currently has no deterministic Unipile write path. Add a same-credential Unipile send implementation for POST /api/v1/users/invite after confirming exact request body against existing code/docs/fixtures, with injected HTTP tests only. Wire runSendTask to try this path first for configured managed Unipile accounts, then fall back to the existing agent/MCP handoff only when deterministic send is unsupported or fails. Other send actions stay connector-required in this board.
doneWhen: send_connection_request attempts deterministic same-credential Unipile send first for configured managed accounts.
Local mutation success and proof debt are recorded only after the external write returns success.

tasks.notes: Implemented deterministic Unipile POST /api/v1/users/invite for connection requests using configured same-credential Unipile API settings. Handoff now carries sender providerAccountId and recipient providerId from synced profile truth. Host runner attempts this path first for live connection_request sends, preserves connector handoff for unsupported/failing direct sends, and only runs local writeback after a direct or connector external sent result.
